coordinate_system.axes: Z is UP (terrain height is Z); X/Y are the ground plane
coordinate_system.origin: level origin (world 0,0,0); all positions absolute. The level sits far from the origin (terrain octree covers +/-0x40000000 units = +/-262144 m about it); that is authored, not an error
coordinate_system.local_origin_note: player spawn; position_local_m = position_m - local_origin_m (use these in a float32 Three.js scene)
coordinate_system.orientation: Real32x9 stored as 3 Euler angles in radians: alpha about X, beta about Y, gamma about Z; matrix R = Rz(gamma).Ry(beta).Rx(alpha) (OpenIGI RetailOrientation, 0x4B38E0); gamma is the yaw about Z; player camera yaw = -gamma. Characters (HumanSoldier/HumanPlayer/Fence) carry a lone Gamma instead (orientation_kind=gamma_only)
coordinate_system.scale_note: terrain.hmp heights (-3.27..+2.70 m) are FINE DETAIL only; the main terrain shape lives in terrain.cmd chunk geometry (not decoded here), so a placement's Z is the authored object height, not a heightmap sample. The yard itself is flat: placement Z p25-p75 spans only ~2-3 m around the median; X spans ~800 m, Y ~1300 m

Task ids are not unique keys: many tasks are anonymous (id -1); use task_index / parent_task_index for linkage.
Train 'Position' is a scalar distance along its rail (RailroadQTaskID -> SplineObj id 1500), not a world point.
SplineObj 'Position' is (0,0,0); rails are defined by their SplineObjWaypoint children (absolute positions).
